source.question_context: Summaries, not verbatim assistant messages; user replies verbatim.

decisions.question_context: Approve release-only production with separate explicit authorization before each release?
decisions.user_reply_verbatim: Yes. As well we expect to have a small non-production, where we're able to test the new functionality doesn't break everything

decisions.question_context: Staging has separate UI/backend, test data and sandbox payments. Automatically deploy after each merge once main checks pass, test there, then authorize production of the tested version; changes require retesting. Automatic or on request?
Sasha sole approver; agent prepares and publishes specific version after explicit authorization; Sasha may publish directly. Anyone else?
Choose checks and independent AI review before automatic merge, or also require human approval per PR. Independent means separate reviewer context. GitHub enforceability remains to verify.
decisions.user_reply_verbatim: Checks + LOOP: [independent AI review (independent personas who are knowledgeble in the area change touches) -> feedback -> fixes] → automatic merge
